name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Ronan: usage-hud (animated pixel-crab usage panel) and html-shelf (one-click file links and copyable code cards in the terminal)

plugins.name: usage-hud
plugins.description: A usage panel under the prompt (model/project/usage grid with quota-pace warnings) and a moody pixel crab walking above it with your subagents

plugins.name: html-shelf
plugins.description: Terminal replies made handier: one-click file links, code cards with Copy / Insert (inline commands too), Copy all, and Open on tool rows
